title: Anna's Town
text:
Anna lives in a small town. There is a big park near her house. In the park, there is a lake and many trees. Every Sunday, Anna walks there with her dog.

The town also has a library and a post office. The library is next to the bank. Anna likes to read books in the library. Her favourite place is the bakery, because the bread is fresh.

questions.text: Where does Anna walk with her dog?
What is next to the library?
What can we guess about Anna from the passage?
options: She lives in a big city

questions.text: Why does Anna probably go to the park every Sunday?
options: She has to work at the bank
The park is closed on other days
The library is closed on Sundays

vocabulary.definition: a place where people can borrow books
a shop that sells bread and cakes
new and not old or stale
a large area of water surrounded by land

paragraph_translations: Anna mieszka w małym miasteczku. Blisko jej domu jest duży park. W parku jest jezioro i wiele drzew. Każdą niedzielę Anna spaceruje tam ze swoim psem.
Miasteczko ma także bibliotekę i pocztę. Biblioteka jest obok banku. Anna lubi czytać książki w bibliotece. Jej ulubione miejsce to piekarnia, bo chleb jest świeży.
